pages.text: What a perfect ice heart. Utterly perfect. Centuries of wintry cold from the snowy plains, all sealed within. Such an exquisite magical material.

It shows you a possibility — a possibility of no longer needing to fear ice magic! If you can channel this power, even the frostbitten reaper will bow to you, turning its scythe against anything that dares stand in your way.

Gather all the cold, merge it, temper it. And so, this focus is born. No longer does it greedily absorb the chill around it; now it unleashes the ancient cold sealed for eons, transforming everything into a realm of death.
Beneath the snow cover, there will only be a few more lost souls.
